1.text: Icyampa ugasatura ijuru ukamanuka, imisozi igatengukira imbere yawe nk'uko umuriro utwika inyayu ukatuza amazi, kugira ngo izina ryawe rimenyekane mu banzi bawe, amahanga agahindira imishyitsi imbere yawe.

2.text: Ubwo wakoraga ibiteye ubwoba tutabyibwiraga, waramanutse imisozi itengukira imbere yawe,

3.text: kuko uhereye kera ntabwo abantu bigeze kumenya, cyangwa kumvisha amatwi no kurebesha amaso, indi mana igira icyo imarira uyitegereza, itari wowe.

4.text: Ubonana n'unezererwa ibyo gukiranuka akabikora, n'abagendera mu nzira zawe bakwibuka, ariko wararakaye kuko twakoze ibyaha, ndetse twabimazemo igihe kirekire. Aho no gukizwa tuzakizwa?

5.text: Kuko twese twahindutse abanduye, kandi n'ibyo twakiranutse byose bimeze nk'ubushwambagara bufite ibizinga, twese turaba nk'ikibabi, kandi gukiranirwa kwacu kudutwara nk'umuyaga.

6.text: Nta wambaza izina ryawe, nta wibatura ngo akugundire kuko watwimye amaso, ukadutsemba uduhoye gukiranirwa kwacu.

7.text: Ariko noneho Uwiteka uri Data wa twese, turi ibumba nawe uri umubumbyi wacu, twese turi umurimo w'intoki zawe.

8.text: Uwiteka, wirakara cyane bikabije, we guhora wibuka gukiranirwa kwacu iteka ryose, turakwinginze witegereze, twese turi abantu bawe.

9.text: Imidugudu yawe yera ihindutse ikidaturwa, i Siyoni habaye ikidaturwa, i Yerusalemu habaye amatongo.

10.text: Inzu yacu yera nziza, aho ba sogokuruza baguhimbarizaga yarahiye, n'ibintu byacu byose binezeza byarononekaye.

11.text: Uwiteka, uziyumanganya kandi bimeze bityo? Uzaceceka utugirire nabi rwose?
